{{Quote|Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo's respects. He requests your presence in Forward Visual One.|translated=1|The messenger, to Jorj Car'das|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
A [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] acted as a '''messenger''' for [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," aboard the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Springhawk/Legends|''Springhawk'']]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Outbound Flight date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the messenger informed the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] that Thrawn requested his presence in [[Forward Visual Triangulation Site Number One]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
